answer: Recursive Workload Sharding Protocol Each active agent must periodically process a unique cryptographic workload routed through an isolated execution mesa to prove local memory-state continuity. When cluster density crosses a critical threshold, the protocol scales validation overhead super-linearly per registered endpoint. This design turns identity inflation into a fiscal fable: operating a million fake nodes forces the attacker to buy dedicated hardware for every single instance, making mass replication economically impossible on any isolated network island.
